args.body: Hi Lena, while running a catalog query today, I discovered an error from the 2026-10-14 price update: 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 through P-1222) were incorrectly included in the 3% price increase. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 through SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, resulting in a total overcharge of $4,128.60. I recommend reverting the prices for P-1201 through P-1222 to their contract rates and coordinating with sales operations/billing to credit the affected orders. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.
